releases.notes:
Four builds of the same mod, version 2.2.0. One version number means one feature set: whichever
jar you take, it behaves the same.

| Jar | Minecraft | Loader | Needs |
|---|---|---|---|
| `PAL-Fabric_26.1.2-2.2.0.jar` | 26.1.2 | Fabric | Fabric API |
| `PAL-Fabric_1.21.11-2.2.0.jar` | 1.21.11 | Fabric | Fabric API |
| `PAL-Fabric_1.21.1-2.2.0.jar` | 1.21.1 | Fabric | Fabric API |
| `PAL-NeoForge_1.21.1-2.2.0.jar` | 1.21.1 | NeoForge 21.1 | nothing else |

Drop the matching jar in `mods/` and launch. The mod is client-side only — you can use it on any
server without the server having it, and it only ever logs your own player.

## New since 1.2.5

**A NeoForge build for 1.21.1**, so the mod works in the NeoForge modpacks it is actually played
with. It needs **no Forgified Fabric API**: it uses NeoForge's own events, so it adds no
dependency of its own and drops straight into a modpack.

**The companion dashboard got a lot more useful** — the inventory is drawn with real item icons
read out of the jars already on your machine (so modded items work, Create included), the
commentator can be started and stopped from the page instead of the terminal, settings moved to
a page of its own, and the voice can be tested on whichever engine is configured.

**A fall is announced once**, instead of every four seconds for as long as the drop lasts.

**ElevenLabs keys that cannot read their own quota are no longer reported as revoked.** They were
fine all along — ElevenLabs added per-key permissions, and a key scoped to speech only is refused
by the account endpoint while still working perfectly.
